data.professional_title: Senior Solution Architect | DevOps & Cloud Expert
data.summary:
Seasoned Azure Cloud Architect with 18 years of IT experience and 5+ years of leadership in cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevOps engineering. Demonstrated excellence in architecting and delivering scalable, secure, and high-availability solutions using Azure native services and automation frameworks.
Proficient in designing enterprise architectures such as microservices, service-oriented architecture (SOA), and 3-tier web applications on Azure IaaS and PaaS. Specialized in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipeline design, Kubernetes orchestration, hybrid networking, and cloud security.
A proven strategic thinker and innovation leader, capable of aligning cloud adoption and modernization initiatives with organizational goals. Brings strong communication skills to articulate technical vision to stakeholders and facilitate collaboration across diverse teams. Skilled in client engagement, ensuring business needs are translated into secure, cost-effective, and scalable solutions. Known for setting the technical direction, mentoring junior engineers, and driving continuous improvement by integrating cutting-edge cloud technologies into enterprise frameworks.
Deep expertise in Azure infrastructure planning, subscription modeling, and multi-tenant governance. Experienced in environment provisioning for complex enterprise workloads including Dynamics 365, Azure AD identity integration, and hybrid connectivity. Adept at leading architecture workshops, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with security and compliance best practices.
Why I’m a Fit: My expertise in DevOps, architectural planning, and cloud modernization is transferable across cloud platforms. While Azure is my primary domain, my engineering approach and delivery methodology align with any enterprise cloud transformation initiative.

all_skills: Azure (Expert – IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, Hybrid Environments)

responsibilities: Designed and implemented 3-tier application architectures across development and production Azure environments.
Built IaC-based deployments using Terraform, Bicep, and ARM templates across subscriptions and tenants.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, including automated build, test, and release flows.
Migrated on-premises legacy applications to Azure, with re-architecture strategies for modernization.
Enabled DevSecOps practices, integrating security and compliance scans into pipelines.
Set up robust monitoring, alerting, and observability using Azure Monitor, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Led workshops with enterprise clients for cloud strategy, modernization roadmap, and solution blueprinting.
Provided architectural governance, reviewed HLD/LLDs, and conducted architecture assessments and design reviews.
Designed cloud infrastructure for hybrid and pure Azure deployments, including development, test, and production environments following Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework.
Led subscription modeling across business units, configuring management groups, policies, and budget controls aligned to governance and enterprise access policies.
Architected secure Azure AD integrations, enabling SSO, MFA, and seamless identity lifecycle management across applications including Dynamics 365 F&O.
Delivered disaster recovery strategies using Azure Site Recovery and backup automation to ensure BCP readiness.
Defined and reviewed architecture artifacts like Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM), Security Design Plans, and Technical Architecture Documents.
Guided cross-functional teams on infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep), Azure DevOps automation, and IaC deployment pipelines.
Advised clients on planning and migration strategies, security posture assessment, and optimization of hybrid workloads.
Led and mentored a cross-functional team of engineers and junior architects on IaC, DevSecOps, and architectural principles.
Spearheaded initiatives for continuous improvement by integrating new cloud-native tools and patterns.
Facilitated knowledge sharing through workshops, documentation, and solution accelerators.
